name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 11 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 11e. Calls for the EU to consider sanctions based on the global financial registry that would target Russian individuals holding more than EUR 10 million in real estate and financial assets (0.02 % of the Russian adult population), since a considerable part of their real estate and financial assets is located in the EU;
